summary: Output pixel budget. Each resolution and aspect-ratio pair maps to fixed dimensions, so 720p plus 21:9 is 1470x630, not a crop. Seedance 2.0 fast stops at 720p.
combines: Drives billing: our matrix charges 4.0 per 1M tokens at 4K against 7.7 at 1080p.
4K output uses 10-bit color and H.265, which some browsers will not play.
2.0: 480p, 720p, 1080p, 4k. 2.0 fast: 480p and 720p only. 2.5: 480p, 720p, 1080p, with no 4k. Default 720p on all three.

usage.from: state.videoResolution, carried from the matrix control the user picked
usage.what: Sets the output frame size for the whole clip. Also selects the billing tier in video-token-accounting, since Seedance prices per resolution.
